settings.for_plan_sellers_adds_a_watermark_opens: For plan sellers. Adds a watermark, opens the viewer without toolbar, measuring or exports, and hides every model download and the full-viewer link on this page. This stops casual copying, not a determined person: the model URL stays reachable and a model shown in a browser can be extracted. For plans that must not leak, upload a simplified preview model and deliver the full set after purchase.
